article.title: Y'all owe the South countless apologies—and other musings on the midterm elections
article.author: Tea Troutman
article.content: Yes, it is indeed historic that the Whole Ass South flipped blue—excluding Florida, but we’ll keep pushing until we get them gators, too. And, yes, you anti-Southern bitches owe the South a big ass apology, and then some. Read more via Scalawag : Y'all owe the South countless apologies—and other musings on the midterm elections .
